S1176.reason: For positive even integers a and b less than 15, the expression a + b + ab can be rewritten as (a+1)(b+1) - 1, so the number of distinct values equals the number of distinct products (a+1)(b+1) with a,b even and less than 15.

S1172.reason: The product of the numbers on the faces of a standard 6-sided die is always even. A composite number is an integer greater than 1 that can be written as a product of more than two prime numbers. Since the product of the numbers on the faces of a standard 6-sided die is always even, it cannot be a composite number.
